scope: Frozen three-file Preview public plan/result/stage/event boundary, including connected integration producer fixtures. No source edit, bootstrap approval or operations.

findings.title: Value-type dispatch bypasses acceptance and native identity field constraints
findings.evidence: publicClone only checks false-only acceptance inside the boolean branch and ID/hash constraints inside the string branch. On the unchanged writer, nested financialComparison.proofAcceptance=true is rejected, but the same field set to string PASS or number 1 is written. Numeric driver.transactionIds[0], numeric native transactionHash, and boolean native input owner also write successfully.
findings.impact: The published boundary is not fail closed for documented nested acceptance/identity types; malformed or truthy acceptance claims can be retained as evidence. This does not assert current honest integration emits those values or that any live result was affected.
findings.requiredCorrection: Validate constrained field types/values independently of the supplied value type before generic cloning. All five acceptance keys must be exactly false when present. Native ID/hash scalar values must have required string encodings; preserve legitimate identifier arrays and nested address/bytes object representations. Add wrong-type controls through actual durable writer, not a mirror helper.

reexecutedChecks.limitation: Existing green tests exercise malformed string values/boolean true but miss nonboolean acceptance and non-string identity values.

checkedScope: Plan exact keys forbid recovery/adapters; configured Preview endpoints and original public payer/seed-path identity are checked without reading private contents. State-directory and second-role provenance still belong to actual launcher/admission.

Connected tests invoke actual Preview integrator/native observer/comparator then durable writers with retained local native transactions and synthetic roles/state fixtures. All four stage summaries and actual 66-hex SDK IDs survive current honest producer path.

Exclusive O_EXCL/O_NOFOLLOW result/stage writes, file and directory fsync, restrictive destination directory/file modes and symlink rejection are present. Private unknown keys, accessors/symbols and arbitrary diagnostic text are rejected in inspected controls.
Failure result optional fields and stopped-event operation text are handled without copying original private SDK error text.
limitations: Current candidate is not approved for publication or operational admission until the type-validation blocker is fixed and corrected frozen source independently reviewed.
No actual Preview transaction, custody, endpoint availability, financial acceptance, mandatory PCD or whole-sprint closure is established.
Only retained public fixtures and temporary synthetic output directories were used; no private inputs, wallets, network, services, proofs or transactions were accessed.
